input: After a successful physical read, return alternating 32-sample blocks of 40000 and 41000 mC; reset the trace at the start of every batch.

excluded_runs.reason: The first attempt stopped before completing all seven measured batches. Replaced with a fresh boot. No partial timing entered the comparison.

sample_unit: Elapsed microseconds per sample. Component medians and total medians are taken separately across the 14 batch averages.
